anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth convex arc with a consistent radius of curvature along the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered protrusion with a pixel length approximately 1.3 times its base thickness.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 150 degrees at the pixel transition from melon to rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Strong cyan-green color cast and saturated specular highlights across the visible body surface.
